resources.string: Turn long videos into viral Shorts
Pick a video or paste a link to one. ClipCraft transcribes it on your phone, AI finds the best moments, then makes vertical clips with animated captions, ready to post on YouTube.
✓ Claude AI is on. Tap to change.
Claude is on but not set up yet. Tap to add your key.
Claude is finding the most viral moments…
Claude found %1$d clips in %2$d words of speech.
Found %1$d clips without Claude (offline). Turn on Claude on the AI page for smarter picks and titles.
No clips found. Is there speech in this video, and is the right language set?
Couldn\'t save to the gallery. Use Share instead.
\"%1$s\" will be uploaded to your channel as a Short (%2$s).
Get a key at console.anthropic.com. It\'s stored only on this phone and used only to ask Claude Haiku for clips. Each video costs about a cent or less.
About your channel (optional, e.g. \"tech tips for students\")
No background music detected in this clip.
I made this video, or I have permission to post it
Any music in it is mine, licensed, or free to use

ClipCraft can\'t check against YouTube\'s copyright database. YouTube does that with Content ID after upload, and ClipCraft will tell you if the video is rejected. Claims that keep the video up are shown only in YouTube Studio.
Checking with YouTube that the Short was accepted…
YouTube is still processing the Short. Check YouTube Studio in a few minutes.
The first upload asks you to sign in with Google and allow uploads to your channel. Uploading private first lets you check a Short before making it public.
%1$d clips are ready to look at.
The video can\'t be opened any more. Share or pick it again.
Finding the speaker to keep them in frame…
\"%1$s\" and its rendered clips will be removed from this phone. Your original video and anything already on YouTube stay.
This project is still being worked on. Try again when it\'s done.
Wait until the current work on this finishes.
Ask for a fresh set of clips? Your current clips, edits and rendered Shorts in this project will be replaced.
%1$d clips will be made (if needed) and uploaded to your channel as Shorts (%2$s).
%1$d upload(s) queued. You can leave the app; progress shows in the notification.
Every clip is already on YouTube.
Scheduled Shorts upload now as private and YouTube makes them public at the time you pick, even if your phone is off.
Pick a time at least 15 minutes from now.
Correct any word. Leave a box empty to remove that caption.
No speech in this clip to caption.
App token (if the server asks for one)
A ClipCraft server holds the Claude key for you and your users, so nobody needs their own. See the server folder in the project to run one.
Boxed (spoken word in a coloured box)
Urdu and Roman Urdu use the AI to rewrite the words (the Hindi/Urdu speech model writes in Hindi script). Timings stay the same.
When the video is wider than a Short, ClipCraft finds the speaker\'s face on your phone and pans the crop to keep them in frame.
Working without Claude (offline). Tap to turn on AI.
Choose how ClipCraft finds your clips. This choice is yours alone and is saved on this phone; anyone else using ClipCraft picks their own.
Claude, with my own API key

Everything stays on your phone and it\'s free. Clips are picked by pace, questions, strong words and the opening line. Captions, editing, reframing and posting all still work. Urdu and Roman Urdu captions need Claude.
Only the transcript text is sent to Claude Haiku, never the video. If Claude can\'t be reached, ClipCraft falls back to offline picks.
The server holds the Claude key, so you don\'t need one. Only the transcript text is sent, never the video. If the server can\'t be reached, ClipCraft falls back to offline picks.
✓ Claude answered. AI clip picks are ready.
Fill in the key or server address first.

Claude understands what is said: it finds punchlines, stories and strong opinions, and writes titles, hooks and hashtags. Offline picks only look at how things are said, and use the opening words as the title. You can switch at any time; use Find clips again on a project to redo its picks.
Paste a link to a video file: Dropbox, Google Drive (shared with \"Anyone with the link\") or a direct .mp4 link. ClipCraft downloads it to your phone first.
